form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Ms. Murkowski (for herself, Mr. Bennet, and Mr. Sullivan) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To amend the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act of 2003 to extend the rural community hospital demonstration program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Rural Community Hospital Demonstration Extension Act of 2020.

section.header: Five-year extension of the rural community hospital demonstration program

paragraph.text: Subsection (a)(5) of section 410A of the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act of 2003 (Public Law 108–173; 42 U.S.C. 1395ww note), is amended by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period.

subparagraph.text: Subsection (g) of such section 410A is amended—

clause.text: in the subsection heading, by striking Ten-Year and inserting Fifteen-Year;

subclause.text: by striking additional 10-year and inserting additional 15-year; and
by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period;

clause.text: in paragraph (2), by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period;
in paragraph (3), by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period;
in paragraph (4), by striking 10-year extension period each place it appears and inserting 15-year extension period;
in paragraph (5), by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period; and
in subparagraph (A) of paragraph (6), by striking 10-year extension period and inserting 15-year extension period.

subparagraph.header: Rule for hospitals that are not original participants in the demonstration
subparagraph.text: Paragraph (5) of subsection (g) of such section 410A is amended—

clause.text: by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: During the third 5 years of the 15-year extension period, the Secretary shall apply the provisions of paragraph (4) to rural community hospitals that are not described in paragraph (4) but are participating in the demonstration program under this section as of December 30, 2019, in a similar manner as such provisions apply to rural community hospitals described in paragraph (4).
Subparagraph (A) of subsection (g)(6) of such section 410A is amended—

clause.text: by striking general.—The Secretary and inserting
by adding at the end the following new clause:

The Secretary shall, notwithstanding subsection (a)(2) or paragraph (2) of this subsection, not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this clause, issue a solicitation for applications to select up to the maximum number of additional rural community hospitals located in any State to participate in the demonstration program under this section for the third 5 years of the 15-year extension period without exceeding the limitation under paragraph (3) of this subsection.

subsection.header: Clarification of application of case mix adjustment
subsection.text: Subsection (b) of such section 410A is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: The Secretary shall provide for an appropriate adjustment under this paragraph to take into account variations in case mix of rural community hospitals, using the most recent case-mix data available.

subsection.text: Subsection (e) of such section 410A is amended by striking Not later than August 1, 2018 and inserting Not later than August 1, 2023.
Such section 410A, as amended by subsections (a), (b), and (c), is further amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a)(1), by inserting of Health and Human Services after Secretary;
in subsection (f)(1)(A)(iv) by inserting of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395i–4) after section 1820; and

subparagraph.text: in the heading of paragraph (4), by striking Hospitals in demonstration program on date of enactment and inserting Hospitals participating in the demonstration program during the initial 5-Year period; and

in clause (i) of paragraph (6)(A), as amended by subsection (a)(2)(C)(i), by striking not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this paragraph and inserting not later than April 12, 2017.
